design_philosophy: Apple-grade refinement inspired by modern Cupertino UI and subtle futuristic precision. Micro-details, crisp surfaces, tactile responsiveness, zero visual clutter.

heading_font.usage: Use class 'font-head' or standard h1-h4 tags. Tight letter-spacing (tracking-tight / -0.02em).

body_font.usage: Standard body text. Clean readability, optimized line heights (leading-relaxed for paragraphs, leading-snug for UI text).

numeric_font.usage: Use class 'font-num' for financial figures, dollar amounts, transaction values, percentages, and metrics. Tabular figures enabled (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`).

size_hierarchy.body_base: text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-300 light:text-slate-700
size_hierarchy.caption_micro: text-[11px] sm:text-xs tracking-wider uppercase font-semibold text-slate-400

border_technique.shimmer_edge: Inset top-shimmer border effect via ::before pseudo-element with 140deg gradient mask for Apple glass look.

micro_interactions_and_motion.principles: Frictionless, weighted springs. Transform and opacity only.

stagger_animation.item: { hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 12 }, show: { opacity: 1, y: 0, transition: { duration: 0.35, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] } } }

net_worth_hero_card.ambient_glow: Radial gradient halo behind value: radial-gradient(400px circle at 80% 20%, rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.08), transparent 70%)
net_worth_hero_card.typography: font-num text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight
net_worth_hero_card.badge: Subtle status pill for spend velocity with green/rose background tint and 1px border

financial_health_ring.glow_effect: Drop-shadow on active stroke for futuristic subtle neon burnish
financial_health_ring.center_text: font-num text-3xl font-extrabold with fun status label in accent emerald color

quick_action_tiles.tile_style: wc-card wc-card-hover p-5 flex flex-col items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl cursor-pointer
quick_action_tiles.icon_container: w-10 h-10 rounded-xl grid place-items-center bg-accent-subtle text-accent

buttons_and_pills.primary_btn: rounded-full bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-semibold px-5 py-2.5 text-sm transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 shadow-[0_4px_16px_rgba(245,166,35,0.3)]
buttons_and_pills.secondary_btn: rounded-full bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-white border border-white/10 px-4 py-2 text-sm transition-all duration-150

tailwind_class_conventions.section_title: font-head text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white dark:text-white light:text-slate-900
tailwind_class_conventions.numeric_display: font-num font-bold tracking-tight text-white dark:text-white light:text-slate-950

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain all existing component routes, logic, and state management in JS files.
Preserve all data-testid attributes across buttons, inputs, links, and text cards.
Ensure both Light and Dark modes remain functional and aesthetically balanced.
Apply hairline gradients and backdrop blurs to wc-card and wc-glass classes in index.css.
Do not use transparent backgrounds without backdrop blurs for sticky headers or dropdown overlays.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_requirement: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute for reliable test execution.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.motion: Ensure smooth micro-interactions on hover and active states using transform and opacity.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner for toast notifications with styled theme-aware popups.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous breathing room with p-6 to p-8 padding on primary dashboard cards.
